stem: What does the author’s use of simile in paragraph 17 of the story “Peace and Quiet” suggest about how Desha feels about her big family?

options.label: A
options.text: Desha thinks no one wants to hear her practice the guitar.

options.label: B
options.text: Desha thinks that there are too many people sharing a space.

options.label: C
options.text: Desha feels a close bond with her sisters because they share a room.

options.label: D
options.text: Desha is uncomfortable with others knowing about her personal life.
